title: The bird on the stone head
logline: The bird on the stone head's brow, in June grass. Two things the town forgot to explain, together. The moss, the colors, the shingle wall.

panels.composition: The moss-grown stone face in June grass by the shingle wall, and on its brow, the rainbow bird, preening. The two unexplained things on one page, in ordinary afternoon light.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a moss-covered carved stone head half sunk in June grass beside a shingle wall with a small rainbow bird preening on its brow, ordinary afternoon light, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
